in_marathi.name: Neelkamal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neelkamal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Neelkamal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Neel' which means 'blue' and 'Kamal' which means 'lotus'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and detachment. The name Neelkamal is often given to a child born on the auspicious day of the full moon or during a religious ceremony held in honor of Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted sitting on a lotus flower. This beautiful name is a reminder of the divine and spiritual nature of life.
